prompt:
Locked-off camera looking straight down, framing holds. The man in the mask closes his raised glove around a cheque, pulls it down to his chest, then nods up at the lens twice on a slow beat. Pale cheques flutter down slowly and settle on hats and the street. The crowd shifts gently in place; every parked 1920s car stays parked and unchanged. Mask and gloves stay the same; nothing new enters the frame. SFX: paper fluttering. Ambient noise: murmuring crowd.

Thanks.
